title: Verify that the page renders correctly on desktop 1920px in English Light theme
description: Published page, EN, Light theme, viewport 1920x1080, matching Figma frame 2824:38277 (1920x2692). Logged-out context.
steps_list: Open a logged-out Chrome window sized 1920x1080 with the site theme set to Light and navigate to /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research
Measure the header, hero, body row and footer geometry and scroll the full page height
expected_list: The viewport reports 1920px wide and the page renders LTR with no horizontal scrollbar

The header is 80px tall with padding 16px 24px, fill #FFFFFF, box-shadow 0 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.25) and a 180x48 logo; the hero uses padding 40px 300px 0px with a 64px inner gap; the body row uses padding 64px 300px with gap 24px, a 312px sticky index rail and a 944px content column with 40px padding-left; the footer uses padding 80px 300px 32px over linear-gradient(90deg,#422C1B 16%,#911731 84%); all three sections and both resource cards are reachable by scrolling with no overlapping or clipped text

title: Verify that the page renders correctly on desktop 1920px in Arabic Light theme
description: Published page, AR, Light theme, viewport 1920x1080, matching Figma frame 2824:38304 (1920x2624). Logged-out context.
steps_list: Open a logged-out Chrome window sized 1920x1080 with the site theme set to Light and navigate to /ar/our-services/information/proposal-for-research
Measure the mirrored layout geometry and scroll the full page height
expected_list: The viewport reports 1920px wide, the document reports dir="rtl" and there is no horizontal scrollbar

The navigation order is mirrored (اتصل بنا first from the right edge inward), the sticky index rail of 312px sits on the RIGHT with the 944px content column on the left, the hero eyebrow/title/description and all section content are right-aligned, and both resource cards render with the 'تحميل' button on the mirrored side; no Arabic text is clipped or overlapped anywhere down the page

title: Verify that the page renders correctly on desktop 1920px in English Dark theme
description: Published page, EN, Dark theme enabled through the shared Header component's Darkmode property, viewport 1920x1080, matching Figma frame 2824:40009.
steps_list: Open a logged-out Chrome window sized 1920x1080, navigate to /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research and enable Dark mode from the header
Scroll the full page height and inspect every section surface, text block and the resource cards for contrast and clipping
expected_list: Dark mode activates without a page error and the page keeps the same 1920px layout geometry (312px rail, 944px content column, 64px 300px body padding)

Every surface switches to the dark palette (#1D1D1B page surface, #343432 and #4A4A49 raised surfaces), every text block stays legible against its surface with no light-theme colour left behind, both resource cards and all ten information-group bullets remain fully visible, and no element is clipped or invisible

title: Verify that the page reflows correctly on mobile 390px in English
description: Published page, EN, Light theme, viewport 390x844, matching Figma frame 2824:38330 (390x3907).
steps_list: Open a logged-out browser at viewport 390x844 and navigate to /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research
Inspect the hero, quick facts, Overview info cards and resource cards and scroll the full page height
expected_list: The viewport reports 390px wide and the page renders with no horizontal scrollbar

The hero title 'Proposal for Research' renders Cairo 700 30px/38px (down from the desktop 48px/60px); the four quick facts stack vertically one per row at 252px wide; the section headings render Cairo 600 18px/28px; the three Overview info cards stack vertically at 262px wide; both resource cards stack with the 'Download' button below the file metadata; the sticky index rail is not shown as a side rail and no content is clipped

title: Verify that the page reflows correctly on a 768px tablet viewport in English
description: Published page, EN, Light theme, viewport 768x1024. No Figma frame exists for tablet (A-9), so this case asserts reflow and legibility rather than exact tokens.
steps_list: Open a logged-out browser at viewport 768x1024 and navigate to /en/our-services/information/proposal-for-research
Scroll the full page height and inspect the hero, quick facts, section index, info cards, information groups and resource cards
expected_list: The viewport reports 768px wide and the page renders with no horizontal scrollbar

Every region reflows to the available width without overlapping: the hero copy wraps inside the viewport, the four quick facts wrap into rows rather than overflowing, the three Overview info cards wrap into a readable grid, all ten information-group bullets wrap without truncation, and both resource cards keep their title, 'PDF', '200 KB' and 'Download' button visible and tappable
